一句话作用: Optimize vector index performance for latency, recall, and memory. Use when tuning HNSW parameters, selecting quantization strategies, or scaling vector search infrastructure.
关键输入: Parameter Default Effect ----------- --------- -------- M 16 Connections per node, ↑ = better recall, more memory efConstruction 100 Build quality, ↑ = better index, slower build efSearch 50 Search quality, ↑ = better recall, slower search
关键输出: 过程辅助，无固定交付物
解决具体问题: 当需要- Tuning HNSW parameters - Implementing quantization - Optimizing memory usage - Reducing search latency - Balancing recall vs speed - Scaling to billions of vectors时，用它完成对应判断、生成或操作流程。
